name: Azimuth V3 (Rule Set 2) - Fusi & Doench 2016
conversion: sklearn GradientBoostingRegressor (100 depth-3 trees, loss=ls) extracted from the sklearn-0.17 pickle and re-serialized as framework-free JSON; predictions verified to reproduce the official azimuth/tests/1000guides.csv fixture (947 guides, max abs error 5.1e-10 for the full model and 5.1e-10 for nopos).
note: Block order matches the Python 2.7 dict iteration order of the original featurization pipeline (verified with a real CPython 2.7.18 build); NGGX one-hot columns are in lexicographic dinucleotide order because the original pandas concat sorted string labels.
